title: Kazen Fecae undead trial
summary: Kazen Fecae tests a necromancer with a chain of undead opponents.
overview: Kazen Fecae tests a necromancer with a chain of undead opponents.

sections.title: Encounter guide
bullets: Complete Kazen’s challenge hand-in with the group ready for the bone golem.
The bone golem’s death summons the next undead challenger at the ritual site.
Remain for the full succession of opponents and complete Kazen’s requested follow-up rather than leaving after the first kill.

notes: Reviewed against quest source only; encounter behavior, database tuning and availability have not been verified in a live zone. Tactical advice is inferred from the scripted mechanics.
